options.content:
### ExternalAuth Lifecycle Overview

Fleet-wide and per-resource view of ExternalAuth provisioning health.
Use the **Subscription** and **Resource ID** dropdowns above to drill into specific resources.

**User Journey**: `PUT ExternalAuth → Accepted → AwaitingSecret → Provisioning → Succeeded`

**SLO targets** (PROPOSED — pending formal review via ARO-25935)
- **Availability**: 99% of ExternalAuths in Succeeded state
- **Timeliness**: 95% of creates completing within 15 minutes
- **Error Rate**: <1% of operations ending in Failed

**Runbook**: [ExternalAuth UJ Runbook](TBD)

panels.title: Total ExternalAuths
panels.description: Total number of ExternalAuth resources across the fleet (or filtered by subscription/resource).

panels.title: Provisioning State Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of ExternalAuth resources by provisioning state.

panels.title: Create >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth create operations running longer than 15 minutes.

targets.expr: count((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|updating"}) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Update >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth update operations running longer than 15 minutes.

targets.expr: count((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="deleting"}) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Delete >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth delete operations running longer than 15 minutes.

panels.title: ExternalAuth Request Rate
panels.description: Rate of HTTP requests to ExternalAuth ARM endpoints (PUT, PATCH, DELETE, GET), per second.

panels.title: ExternalAuth Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Frontend HTTP response latency for ExternalAuth endpoints. This is the time from ARM request receipt to synchronous response (not the full async operation duration).

panels.title: ExternalAuth Error Rate by Code
panels.description: Rate of 4xx and 5xx responses for ExternalAuth endpoints. Spikes here indicate validation failures (4xx) or server errors (5xx) at the ARM API layer.

targets.expr: (time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"}) * on(resource_id, subscription_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) group_left() backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"}

panels.title: Active Operations
panels.description: All currently in-flight ExternalAuth operations with their elapsed duration. Color indicates severity: green (<5m), yellow (5-15m), red (>15m).

panels.title: In-Flight Operation Duration
panels.description: Real-time elapsed duration of each in-flight ExternalAuth operation. Rising lines indicate stuck operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.5, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p50
panels.description: Median duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.95, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.99, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p99
panels.description: 99th percentile duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

panels.title: Longest In-Flight Op
panels.description: Duration of the longest currently in-flight ExternalAuth operation.

panels.title: Completed Ops (7d TTL)
panels.description: Total completed ExternalAuth operations within the 7-day Cosmos TTL window.

targets.expr: count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"}) / count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) * 100

panels.description: Percentage of completed ExternalAuth operations that succeeded.

targets.expr: backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}

panels.title: Operation Duration by Type (Completed)
panels.description: Duration of completed ExternalAuth operations (last_transition_time - start_time). Only visible within the 7-day Cosmos TTL window.

panels.title: Fleet Availability
panels.description: Percentage of ExternalAuth resources currently in Succeeded provisioning state.

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) < 900) / count((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"})) * 100

panels.title: Timeliness SLO (Create <15m)
panels.description: Percentage of completed ExternalAuth create operations that finished within 15 minutes.

targets.expr: count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}) / count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) * 100

panels.title: Operation Error Rate

panels.title: In-Flight Operations
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth operations currently in non-terminal phases.

panels.title: Fleet Availability Over Time
panels.description: Fleet-wide ExternalAuth availability over time.

panels.title: Provisioning State Over Time
panels.description: ExternalAuth count by provisioning state over time.

panels.title: Parent Cluster State Distribution
panels.description: Provisioning state of parent HCP clusters in the selected subscription(s). ExternalAuth can only succeed if the parent cluster is in Succeeded state.

panels.title: Clusters Not in Succeeded State
panels.description: HCP clusters NOT in Succeeded state. ExternalAuth operations on these clusters will fail or remain stuck. Check cluster health first before investigating ExternalAuth issues.

panels.title: Failed Operations by Type
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by operation type (create/update/delete).

panels.title: Failed Operations by Subscription
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by subscription.

panels.title: Failed ExternalAuths by Subscription
panels.description: Count of ExternalAuth resources currently in Failed provisioning state, grouped by subscription.

targets.expr: backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}
